//: Compiler options shared by every project in the workspace.
Deliberately NOT named tsconfig.base.json: five vendored pi package configs
already declare `extends: ../../tsconfig.base.json` against a file that does
not exist in this repo. Creating that filename would silently activate those
stale configs with upstream's options. See #82.
Holds only the unused-code flags: every package tsconfig keeps its own
target/module/lib settings, which differ across the vendored packages.
